description: Katalog fiktif toko kelontong online: 16 produk, 3 kategori. Dua produk belum punya rating (NULL) — bahan latihan ORDER BY dan IS NULL. Dipakai buat belajar ORDER BY dan LIMIT.

samples.label: termurah dulu
samples.sql: SELECT nama, harga FROM produk ORDER BY harga ASC;

samples.label: rating tertinggi
samples.sql: SELECT nama, rating FROM produk ORDER BY rating DESC;

samples.label: 5 termahal
samples.sql: SELECT nama, harga FROM produk ORDER BY harga DESC LIMIT 5;

samples.label: yang belum dirating
samples.sql: SELECT nama FROM produk WHERE rating IS NULL;

subtitle: Toko Kelontong Online · 16 baris
title: Katalog Produk
